question: In February 2022, Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare announced the launch of ______, which is a doorstep distribution drive to deliver crop insurance policies to farmers under the Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY).
solution:
The correct answer is __** "Meri Policy Mere Hath."**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **" Meri Policy Mere Hath" is a doorstep distribution drive launched by the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare in February 2022.**
 
• The main objective of this drive is to** deliver crop insurance policies to farmers under the Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) scheme.**
 
• This initiative **aims to provide hassle-free and timely delivery of crop insurance policies to farmers at their doorstep, thus ensuring the financial security of farmers in case of crop loss or damage.**
 
• **This drive will also help in increasing the coverage of crop insurance and promoting financial inclusion among farmers.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Saubhagya scheme:** This is a government scheme launched in September 2017 to provide electricity connections to all households in rural and urban areas.
 
• **SEED scheme: **This is a government scheme launched in 2011 to promote entrepreneurship and self-employment among the youth of the country.
 
• ** Kaushal Yojana:** This is a government scheme launched in 2015 to provide skill training and employment opportunities to the youth of the country.
